title: NATO Pledges €70 Billion for Ukraine, Reaffirms 'Ironclad' Article 5 Commitment at Ankara
detail: NATO's 32 members closed the Ankara Leaders' Summit on July 8, 2026 by pledging €70 billion ($80B) in military aid to Ukraine for 2026, with an equivalent commitment for 2027 — about 30 billion euros drawn from the EU's existing 90 billion euro loan facility and roughly 40 billion euros from individual member bilateral programs. The closing communiqué reaffirmed 'our ironclad commitment to collective defence as enshrined in Article 5 of the Washington Treaty — that an attack on one is an attack on all,' and, notably, was denominated in euros rather than dollars for the first time, underscoring that European allies and Canada now finance the vast majority of security assistance to Kyiv. Allied leaders also credited the Hague 2025 pledge with driving a $139 billion increase in European and Canadian core defense investment since 2025.

media.caption: NATO allies pledge 70 billion euros in defense help to Ukraine at Ankara summit

title: Trump Orders Trade Cutoff with Spain, Renews Push to Take Control of Greenland at NATO Summit
detail: On the summit's second day, Trump publicly ordered Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to 'cut off all trade with Spain, please, including visits,' calling Madrid 'a wasted cause' and 'a terrible partner in NATO' over its refusal to commit to the new 5% GDP defense-spending target and its earlier restriction on US use of the Rota and Morón bases during the Iran campaign. In the same appearance alongside Secretary General Rutte, Trump repeated that Greenland 'should be controlled by the United States, not by Denmark,' prompting Danish PM Mette Frederiksen to respond 'this is not going to happen.' Trump's tone shifted within a day: on the return flight to Washington he told reporters 'Spain came back all the way today. Spain was very generous today,' softening the trade-cutoff threat without a formal reversal.

media.caption: Trump threatens Spain trade, demands US take over Greenland at NATO summit
